title: What the assistant was given — contract

steps.path: Chat → the strip at the top of the conversation → Details
steps.headline: This is what done means for the panel that shows what the assistant was given.

rows.statement: The panel is built from the same dialog pieces as the app's other settings dialogs, not its own hand-drawn look.
The header shows the panel's title, one short line beneath it, and a close cross at the right, above a hairline.
When something was left out, the app's standard warning box says so at the top, and no model pill appears.
Sections are introduced by small uppercase labels rather than cards carrying headings of their own.
Each item is a rounded row with a chevron, spaced exactly like the rows in the Preferences dialog.
Model, context window and what was given sit as three plain rows under THIS CHAT, each value on the right.
There is no footer button; Assistant settings is a row with a chevron that leads onward.
Quoted file content sits on the app's deepest surface behind a hairline, at the app's small caption size.
What it got and What was cut are the app's own tabs; Open sits beside a file as a small row button.
When nothing was left out, the same restyled panel appears in its green everything-fit state.
In the green state one green-dot line inside a card replaces the warning box, above the tabs, THIS CHAT and MORE.
With nothing cut there is no list of cuts, only the three facts and the settings row.
